entries.scope: Fleet-wide Stage-B control plane, serial repository rollout, provider governance, acceptance evidence, accessibility, security, architecture and operating documentation
entries.rationale: Stage B adds user-visible preview, delivery, resume and verification contracts plus security-sensitive remote and ruleset boundaries. One feature-wide decision keeps reader paths, language, platform, distribution and closeout evidence causally reviewable.
entries.navigationImpact: README and script reference lead from the mutations-free preview to quickstart, manpage/help, assurance documents, evidence and the separately authorized G4 sequencing follow-up.
entries.languageStrategy: German first with English companion content at approximately CEFR B2; stable command names and machine fields remain unchanged.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Pending T107 and T110-T125: native or hash-bound macOS, Linux and Windows evidence must prove the paired Bash and PowerShell examples without inventing platform tokens.
entries.risk: Remote, platform, provider and Home-sync evidence is pending; missing evidence blocks delivery and completion.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Fleet, profile, authority, bypass, provider, ruleset, platform, evidence schema, distribution, audience, shared guidance or G4 boundary changes.

distributionReview.rationale: Runtime paths are manifest-bound homeRuntime, but synchronization remains blocked until preview, conflict checks, Level-0 merge and fresh authority pass.

sharedGuidanceReview.rationale: Initial disposition only: Stage B implements accepted feature semantics and does not yet change shared guidance. T121 must revalidate this decision after implementation.
sharedGuidanceReview.residualRisk: A later shared-guidance trigger would require an atomic update across all maintained surfaces.
sharedGuidanceReview.reevaluationTrigger: Any shared guidance, Constitution, template, statistics-methodology or routing-role change.
